thread:
priya: Incoming customer request — BrightMart wants us to onboard halcyon-13b-rlhf-v2 for their search + summarization pipeline. They asked for hosted API + option for Dedicated later. Initial ask: low latency for 512 token completions, embedding endpoint too. Attaching model link from S3. Need triage: compatibility, quant path, eval plan, timeline.

 diego: Can you paste the model format / HF repo? We need to know if it's FlashAttention-friendly and if kv-caching works out of the box.

 priya: s3://brightmart/models/halcyon-13b-rlhf-v2.tar.gz — HF transformers-compatible. They included a custom lm_head though.

 maya: OK — quick checklist:
- weight dtype: fp16? fp32? -> check
- vocab/tokenizer -> check
- config attention type -> check
- test load w/ hf transformers

 sophia: Perf targets from customer?

 priya: P50 < 130ms for 512 tokens (streaming), sustain 20 RPS for 4 concurrent clients. Latency SLO is tight.

 alex: Suggest flow: 1) smoke load on CPU/GPU dev node, 2) run int8 and int4 quant pipelines (bitsandbytes + PTQ) on a sample eval set, 3) run quality regression vs our baseline, 4) perf bench in triton runtime.

 alex: Quick command to run eval:
```bash
./run_eval --model halcyon-13b --input eval_prompts.jsonl --batch 1 --seq 512 --quant int4 --metrics ppl,exact_match
```

 alex: Note: if tokenizer is custom, quant pipelines may need special handling; watch for tied weights and lm_head offset.

 eval-bot: scheduled evaluation run #3784 for halcyon-13b-rlhf-v2 (int8, int4). ETA 2h.

 maya: Risks:
- custom lm_head incompatible with our kernels
- quantization could cause hallucination regressions; need targeted evals
- streaming API changes required for prefix caching

 diego: Infra: can reserve a p4d for preliminary runs and 1x a100-80 for quant passes. I can provision tomorrow.

 priya: Proposed assignees:
- load + smoke: maya
- quant experiments: alex
- eval/regression: sophia
- infra provisioning: diego

 priya: Next steps: maya will confirm loadability today; alex starts PTQ experiments after that. We'll sync in #eng-ml tomorrow 10am PT. @everyone please react with :white_check_mark: if you agree or :eyes: if you need more time.
